toolbox_name: SparkFun RFD77402 I2C Laser Distance Sensor

rfd77402_init.tooltip: Create and initialize RFD77402 I2C laser distance sensor

rfd77402_take_measurement.tooltip: Trigger RFD77402 to perform one measurement

rfd77402_get_distance.tooltip: Read distance measured by RFD77402 in millimeters Returns −1 if the latest measurement failed.

rfd77402_get_valid_pixels.tooltip: Read RFD77402 valid pixel count (0-9) Returns −1 if the latest measurement failed.

rfd77402_get_confidence.tooltip: Read RFD77402 measurement confidence value Returns −1 if the latest measurement failed.

rfd77402_get_status.tooltip: 0 = valid; 1–3 = optical error; 4 = no new sample; 5 = timeout; 6 = I²C transfer or initialization failed.
